name.text: Probability of Vowels Placed Together in Word Arrangement

questiontext.text:
Consider the word {@word@}

The letters of the word {@word@} are written, one on each of {@cards@} cards.
The cards are laid out in line. Determine the probability that the vowels are placed together.

Note: Give you answer in exact form or correct to \(3\) decimal places

\(P(\text{vowels together}) = \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Total number of arrangements \( \displaystyle = \frac{{@cards@}!}{2!2!2!}={@total_arrangements@}\), as there are three pairs of repeated letters.

There are \(\displaystyle \frac{{@4@}!}{2!}\) ways of arranging the vowels into a chunk, there are \(\displaystyle \frac{{@7@}!}{2!2!}\) ways of arranging the consonants into a chunk, and there are \(8\) ways of inserting the chunk of vowels somewhere in front, between or after the consonants. Thus we get:

Number of arrangements with vowels together \( \displaystyle = 8 \times \frac{{@7@}!}{2!2!} \times \frac{{@4@}!}{2!}={@vowels_together_arrangements@}\)

\(\displaystyle P(\text{vowels together}) = \frac{{@vowels_together_arrangements@}}{{@total_arrangements@}}={@ta@} \approx {@decimalplaces(ta,3)@}\)
